title:
This type represents an entity that can resolve itself based on a given dataset preparation run.
The purpose of this entity is to adjust its parameters dynamically based on the features and data
prepared during a dataset preparation run, making it easier to automate the model training process.
The `resolveForDatasetPreparationRun` function allows for automatic resolution of certain parameters
based on the dataset provided in the `ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun`.
name: ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRunResolvable
